why: Nike's Jumpman label: Air Jordan sneakers around $105–$185 plus fleece, jerseys and pants for women, sold on nike.com, in Nike and Jordan stores and Nordstrom.

quote.q: Our Jordan Brand designs, distributes and licenses athletic and casual footwear, apparel and accessories predominantly focused on sport performance and streetwear using the Jumpman trademark.

doors.note: Jordan Brand is owned by Nike, Inc.; Jordan product is sold through Nike stores (~290 US Nike-bannered doors incl. factory/clearance, not counted here) and wholesale. Only one US door is Jordan-bannered: Jordan World of Flight, Philadelphia. Other 'Jordan' hits were place names (Jordan Creek Town Center IA, West Jordan UT Nike Factory). Footwear/sportswear brand, not a womenswear brand. 'Closed' on the read was just the daily hours status.
